work.description: Designed and implemented software ecosystems combining high-performance C++ services, JavaScript/Node.js backends, automated deployments, and quantitative research for client projects. Built APIs serving 10,000+ users across two frontend applications. Key insights and achievements: - Developed and backtested a quantitative trading strategy in C++, achieving positive results for a client project. - Architected and deployed backend services using Docker, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud Run, creating an automated and scalable deployment workflow. Designed a hybrid API architecture using C++ for performance-critical endpoints and JavaScript/Fastify for services requiring more complex business logic.

projects.name: Cloud-Native API Architecture — Docker & Google Cloud Run
projects.description: Designed and deployed a distributed backend ecosystem using Docker and Google Cloud Run, with independently deployed API services supporting two frontend applications and 10,000+ users. The architecture combines high-performance C++ services for latency-sensitive endpoints with Node.js/Fastify services for more complex business logic, enabling modular development, independent scaling, and automated deployments.

projects.name: Quant Trading Strategy — Backtesting & Live Execution
projects.description: Developed and validated a quantitative trading strategy through backtesting and live execution on XAUUSD using C++. The project involved translating trading logic into an automated Expert Advisor, analyzing execution and P&L, and monitoring real-time performance. The strategy generated positive results during the observed testing period, reaching $6,091.83 in cumulative balance.

work.description: Built an audience of 4,000+ followers across social media (YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok) through educational and narrative-driven content. Key highlights include: - Created content exploring psychology, philosophy, economics, power dynamics, motivation, and human behavior. - Translated complex ideas into accessible stories and short-form educational content. - Developed a distinctive content framework combining storytelling, intellectual analysis, and practical insights. - Researched and synthesized ideas from philosophy, economics, psychology, and history for a general audience.

projects.name: TikTok account
projects.description: One interesting thing I learned about TikTok is that building an audience can be more challenging when the content feels overly produced or written. The platform tends to reward authenticity and personality. Through experimentation, I discovered that my most successful videos were the ones where I spoke genuinely and shared ideas from a personal perspective. This taught me how important authenticity, emotional connection, and storytelling are when creating content for short-form video.

projects.name: Instagram account
projects.description: Here, I learned that the algorithm needs to understand who you are and what your content is about before it can consistently connect you with the right audience. Once that connection becomes clearer, you start to see something more valuable than individual viral posts: a community taking shape. I also learned that Instagram can make virality more sustainable when you build trust with your audience. When people feel connected to your ideas, they become the ones who amplify your content.

projects.name: YouTube account
projects.description: Here, I discovered that YouTube is challenging because viewers actively choose what they want to watch. This taught me that the topic and how you package it are critical. You have to continuously test what people want to learn, then deliver enough value to keep them watching. When you get it right, you build a stronger connection with an audience that intentionally chose your content.
